description: This is an abstract test class for policy event strategy implementations in the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up common test logic for handling policy events and verifying modifications to Policy objects.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategyTest
classes.description: An abstract generic test class for testing policy event strategies, providing setup and common test methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test objects before each test method execution.

methods.name: testHandleReturnsNullForNullEntity
methods.description: Verifies that handling a null entity returns null.

methods.name: testHandlePolicyEvent
methods.description: Verifies that handling a policy event modifies the Policy object as expected.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to add extra assertions on the modified Policy.

methods.name: getInstant
methods.description: Provides access to the current timestamp used in tests.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the specific EventStrategy implementation being tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to create a PolicyEvent instance with a given timestamp and Policy.
